High-level groupings:

Standard Token Interfaces
  – `IERC20Minimal.sol`, `IERC20Metadata.sol`, `IERC20Mintable.sol`, `IERC20Burnable.sol`, `IERC721Enumerable.sol`

Protocol-Specific Interfaces
  – `IAlchemicToken.sol`, `IAlchemistV3.sol`, `IAlchemistV3Position.sol`, `IAlchemistETHVault.sol`, `IAlchemistTokenVault.sol`, `IFeeVault.sol`, `IWhitelist.sol`, `ITransmuter.sol`

Yield / Wrapping & Vault Interfaces
  – `IWETH.sol`, `IYieldToken.sol`, `IYearnVaultV2.sol`, `ITokenAdapter.sol`, `test/ITestYieldToken.sol`
Let’s skim the `Standard Token` interfaces first.
IERC20Minimal exposes totalSupply, balanceOf, allowance, transfer, approve, transferFrom plus the Transfer and Approval events.
IERC20Metadata extends ERC-20 with name, symbol and decimals getters.
IERC20Mintable adds a single mint(recipient, amount) method.
IERC20Burnable offers burn(amount) and burnFrom(owner, amount).
IERC721Enumerable (OpenZeppelin) brings totalSupply and per-owner / global enumeration helpers.
Next up: Alchemix-specific contracts and helpers.
`IAlchemicToken` extends `ERC-20` with mint accounting (`hasMinted`, `lowerHasMinted`) and admin controls for ceilings & whitelist.
IAlchemistV3Actions – key user calls: approveMint, poke, deposit, withdraw, mint, mintFrom, burn, repay, liquidate, batchLiquidate, redeem, resetMintAllowances.
`IAlchemistV3Events` publishes state changes such as `Deposit`, `Withdraw`, `Mint`, `Burn`, `Liquidated`, plus **admin/guardian updates**.
`IAlchemistV3Position` is the **ERC-721** wrapper for user positions: `mint`, `burn`, `alchemist()` and enumeration functions.
`IAlchemistETHVault` manages `WETH` liquidity – `depositWETH`, `withdraw`, `setAlchemist`, `balance` and `totals`.
`IAlchemistTokenVault` is the **ERC-20** vault analogue with deposit, withdraw and authorised-withdrawer management.
IFeeVault is minimal: `token()`, `totalDeposits()`, `withdraw(recipient, amount)`.
`IWhitelist` – `add`, `remove`, `disable`, `isWhitelisted` plus corresponding events.
ITransmuter key getters: `alchemist()`, `admin()`, `syntheticToken()`, `depositCap()`, `timeToTransmute`, `fees`, etc.
User actions on the Transmuter: `getPosition`, `createRedemption`, `claimRedemption`, `queryGraph`; more admin setters below.
Finally, external `yield` / `wrapping` & `vault interfaces`.
IWETH = `ERC-20` + `deposit()` and `withdraw(amount)`.
`IYieldToken` provides a single `price()` view for generic yield tokens.
`IYearnVaultV2` – rich vault API: `deposit/withdraw` variants, `strategies()`, `pricePerShare`, `totalAssets`, `creditAvailable`, etc.
`ITokenAdapter` is Alchemix’s abstraction around any yield token: `version()`, `token()`, `underlyingToken()`, `price()`.
`ITestYieldToken` – test helper with `underlyingToken()`, `price()`, `mint`, `redeem`, `slurp` and `siphon`.

Recap:  Standard token wrappers guarantee **ERC compliance**; protocol-specific interfaces dictate how debt, vaults and redemptions work inside `Alchemix V3`; yield/vault interfaces let Alchemix interact safely with external wrappers like `WETH` or `Yearn`.  Everything external to core logic must obey these signatures—this set of interfaces is the **public contract of the system**.
